item.title: Netanyahu wary of Egypt's military might and uncertain about ultimate US move on Iran
item.description: Israeli PM Benjamin Netanyahu tells Knesset committee that Egyptian army is building its strength, "which needs to be monitored," adding he remains unsure of Trump's final decision on Tehran.

item.title: Carney calls Türkiye a 'vital partner' for Canada
item.description: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney notes opportunities to strengthen commercial ties with Türkiye, saying he had already initiated talks with President Recep Tayyip Erdogan.

item.title: 'We ask for forgiveness' — Venezuela advances amnesty bill for political prisoners
item.description: Legislation aims to free those detained for political reasons between 1999 and present day and will lead to release of hundreds of opposition figures, journalists and activists.

item.title: Trump introduces 'TrumpRx', an online store with discounted weight-loss and fertility drugs
item.description: TrumpRx.gov lists 43 prescription drugs with discounts for conditions like asthma, infertility, and obesity.

item.title: US virtual embassy tells Americans to leave Iran 'now' amid increasing restrictions and risks
item.description: Security alert cites internet blackouts, transport disruptions, and rising risks of detention

item.title: US military strikes suspected 'drug-trafficking' vessel in Eastern Pacific
item.description: Two alleged 'narco-terrorists' killed, says US Southern Command, adding no American forces were harmed.

item.title: Türkiye-Iraq ties gain momentum amid shared security and regional shifts, says SETA
item.description: Experts say institutionalisation, counterterrorism cooperation, and economic connectivity are reshaping the bilateral agenda.

item.title: 'A valuable new beginning': Damascus Book Fair returns under President al Sharaa
item.description: Syria's flagship literary event reopens under new leadership, with President Ahmed al Sharaa casting the fair as a symbol of renewal and knowledge-led rebuilding

item.title: UN raises alarm over reports of Israel spraying herbicide near Lebanon border
item.description: UNIFIL warns of risks to civilians, farmland and post-war recovery after claims of chemical dispersal along the Blue Line revive environmental and legal concerns
